## context7-01 — Pest 5 arch testing expectations

- Tool: context7 `resolve-library-id` («Pest PHP») → `/pestphp/docs`; `query-docs` · Date: 2026-09-29
- Query: «arch testing: expect namespace toOnlyBeUsedIn, toBeInterfaces, toBeEnums, ignoring, wildcards in namespace expectations, arch presets»

## Answer (verbatim snippets)

- `toBeInterfaces()` — https://github.com/pestphp/docs/blob/5.x/arch-testing.md — «Ensures all files in a namespace are interfaces.» `arch('app')->expect('App\Contracts')->toBeInterfaces();`
- `toBeEnums()` — same source — `arch('app')->expect('App\Enums')->toBeEnums();`
- Wildcards in `expect()` — same source — «The first example matches any App\*\Traits namespace, while the second matches any App\*\*\Traits namespace.» `arch()->expect('App\*\Traits')->toBeTraits(); arch()->expect('App\*\*\Traits')->toBeTraits();`
- `ignore()` / `ignoreGlobalFunctions()` in `tests/Pest.php` — same source.
- Rules example: `arch()->expect('App\Models')->toBeClasses()->toExtend('Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model')->toOnlyBeUsedIn('App\Repositories')->ignoring('App\Models\User'); arch()->expect('App\Http')->toOnlyBeUsedIn('App\Http'); arch()->preset()->php();`
